title: 눈치로 읽기: 이 말, 진짜 뜻은 뭐예요?
objective: By the end, learners can tell what a speaker really wants from common Korean hints and use 눈치가 빠르다, 눈치가 없다, and 눈치를 보다 correctly.
summary: Learners read common Korean hint expressions and find the real request or refusal behind the words.
note: The same words can be a real question in another situation, so always check the context.

task.title: Find the real meaning
task.line: Read each situation, think about what the speaker really wants, and then choose or write the answer.

sections.heading: What is 눈치?
paragraphs: 눈치 (nunchi) means sensing what someone wants without being told. Koreans often hint instead of asking directly, especially with elders, bosses, and people they don't know well. A direct "no" or "close the window" can sound too strong.

items.text: Often a soft request to close the window or turn up the heat.
items.example: 좀 춥지 않아요? 창문이 열려 있네요.

items.text: The speaker wants to finish the meeting or leave.
A polite way to say no.
items.example: 죄송한데 이번 주는 좀 어려울 것 같아요.

items.text: When someone gives only a reason and stops, it usually means no.
Often a gentle no, especially to a seller.
Tells you that a request is coming.
Describes someone who understands without being told.
items.example: 수진 씨는 눈치가 빨라서 말 안 해도 다 알아요.
그 사람은 눈치가 없어서 회의 때 계속 농담을 해요.

items.text: To be careful about what others think before you act.
items.example: 다들 일하고 있어서 퇴근할 때 눈치를 봤어요.

steps.en: Notice the time, place, and person
Ask: what does this person want?
Reply with an action or a soft answer

exercises: Choose the real meaning. At 11 p.m. at a friend's home, your friend says: "나 내일 아침에 일찍 나가야 되는데…" (a) Please stay longer. (b) It is time for you to go home.
You invited a friend to meet on Saturday. Is each reply Yes or No? ① 토요일은 제가 좀 바빠서요. ② 좋아요, 몇 시에 만날까요? ③ 가고 싶은데 그날은 집에 일이 좀 있어서요.

Choose what the coworker really wants. Your coworker has been staring at an English document with a worried face for a long time. Then your coworker holds the document out toward you and says: "혹시 영어로 된 서류 읽을 줄 아세요?" (a) They are just curious about your English. (b) They want you to help them read a document.
Choose the reply that shows good 눈치. A grandmother says: "아이고, 이 가방이 왜 이렇게 무겁지?" ⓐ 네, 정말 무거워 보여요. ⓑ 제가 들어 드릴게요.
Fill in the blank with 빨라요, 없어요, or 눈치를: ① 말을 안 했는데 지훈 씨가 먼저 물을 가져다줬어요. 지훈 씨는 눈치가 ____. ② 새 회사라서 점심 메뉴도 선배들 ____ 보면서 골라요. ③ 친구가 계속 시계를 보는데 민호는 계속 이야기했어요. 민호는 눈치가 ____.
answers: (b) It is time for you to go home.
① No ② Yes ③ No
(b) They want you to help them read a document.
① 빨라요 ② 눈치를 ③ 없어요
